blocks.text: Śiva Sūtras 3.29
blocks.directed: [long pause] Śiva Sūtras 3.29

blocks.text: योऽविपस्थो ज्ञाहेतुश्च
blocks.directed: [slowly] योऽविपस्थो ज्ञाहेतुश्च

blocks.text: Yo ’vipastho jñāhetuś ca.
blocks.directed: Yo ’vipastho jñāhetuś ca.

blocks.text: The one established in sovereignty over the powers is a source of liberating knowledge.
blocks.directed: The one established in sovereignty over the powers is a source of liberating knowledge.

blocks.text: Not Everyone Who Knows Sanskrit Is Qualified to Be Your Guru.
blocks.directed: Not Everyone Who Knows Sanskrit Is Qualified to Be Your Guru.

blocks.text: Now this is a particularly interesting sūtra.
blocks.directed: Now this is a particularly interesting sūtra.

blocks.text: And it requires careful explanation.
blocks.directed: And it requires careful explanation.

blocks.text: Because the Sanskrit is unusual.
blocks.directed: Because the Sanskrit is unusual.

blocks.text: Let’s begin.
blocks.directed: Let’s begin.

blocks.text: Yaḥ — he who.
blocks.directed: Yaḥ — he who.

blocks.text: Avipasthaḥ — interpreted by Kṣemarāja through a special tantric derivation.
blocks.directed: Avipasthaḥ — interpreted by Kṣemarāja through a special tantric derivation.

blocks.text: Jñā — knowledge, or the knowing power.
blocks.directed: Jñā — knowledge, or the knowing power.

blocks.text: Hetuḥ — cause, source, means.
blocks.directed: Hetuḥ — cause, source, means.

blocks.text: Ca — and, also; Kṣemarāja understands it here in an emphatic sense.
blocks.directed: Ca — and, also; Kṣemarāja understands it here in an emphatic sense.

blocks.text: Now, the central difficulty is avipasthaḥ.
blocks.directed: Now, the central difficulty is avipasthaḥ.

blocks.text: Kṣemarāja explicitly gives an interpretive analysis involving avi, a term associated with the bound beings.
blocks.directed: Kṣemarāja explicitly gives an interpretive analysis involving avi, a term associated with the bound beings.

blocks.text: And pa, the protector.
blocks.directed: And pa, the protector.

blocks.text: The powers presiding over the bound beings are therefore brought into the interpretation.
blocks.directed: The powers presiding over the bound beings are therefore brought into the interpretation.

blocks.text: Remember the goddesses from 3.19?
blocks.directed: Remember the goddesses from 3.19?

blocks.text: The Mothers.
blocks.directed: The Mothers.

blocks.text: The powers of Mātṛkā.
blocks.directed: The powers of Mātṛkā.

blocks.text: The divine forces associated with differentiated cognition.
blocks.directed: The divine forces associated with differentiated cognition.

blocks.text: Well, now the realised yogi is said to be established in sovereignty over those powers.
blocks.directed: Well, now the realised yogi is said to be established in sovereignty over those powers.

blocks.text: He is no longer merely governed by them through unconscious limitation.
blocks.directed: He is no longer merely governed by them through unconscious limitation.

blocks.text: Rather, he knows their true source.
blocks.directed: Rather, he knows their true source.

blocks.text: And therefore possesses the capacity to communicate liberating knowledge.
blocks.directed: And therefore possesses the capacity to communicate liberating knowledge.

blocks.text: Now, this is a crucial distinction.
blocks.directed: Now, this is a crucial distinction.

blocks.text: The ordinary individual is subject to the powers of differentiated cognition.
blocks.directed: The ordinary individual is subject to the powers of differentiated cognition.

blocks.text: The realised yogi recognises those powers as manifestations of Śakti.
blocks.directed: The realised yogi recognises those powers as manifestations of Śakti.

blocks.text: And this recognition changes their relationship to the entire śakticakra.
blocks.directed: And this recognition changes their relationship to the entire śakticakra.

blocks.text: The wheel of powers.
blocks.directed: The wheel of powers.

blocks.text: The yogi is no longer simply a dependent subject carried along by the processes of cognition.
blocks.directed: The yogi is no longer simply a dependent subject carried along by the processes of cognition.

blocks.text: The powers are understood through their supreme source.
blocks.directed: The powers are understood through their supreme source.

blocks.text: And now the extraordinary implication.
blocks.directed: And now the extraordinary implication.

blocks.text: Only someone established in genuine recognition can fully perform the liberating function of the teacher described in the preceding sūtra.
blocks.directed: Only someone established in genuine recognition can fully perform the liberating function of the teacher described in the preceding sūtra.

blocks.text: At 3.28, we learned:
blocks.directed: [short pause] At 3.28, we learned:

blocks.text: Dānam ātmajñānam.
blocks.directed: [slowly] Dānam ātmajñānam.

blocks.text: The gift is knowledge of the Self.
blocks.directed: The gift is knowledge of the Self.

blocks.text: But how can someone communicate that recognition if they remain fundamentally confused about their own nature?
blocks.directed: But how can someone communicate that recognition if they remain fundamentally confused about their own nature?

blocks.text: And that’s Kṣemarāja’s question.
blocks.directed: And that’s Kṣemarāja’s question.

blocks.text: A person who remains entirely subordinate to the powers of differentiated cognition cannot, simply by possessing information, exercise the same transformative authority attributed to the realised teacher.
blocks.directed: A person who remains entirely subordinate to the powers of differentiated cognition cannot, simply by possessing information, exercise the same transformative authority attributed to the realised teacher.

blocks.text: Now, this shouldn’t be exaggerated into the claim that anyone who lacks enlightenment is incapable of explaining anything useful.
blocks.directed: Now, this shouldn’t be exaggerated into the claim that anyone who lacks enlightenment is incapable of explaining anything useful.

blocks.text: Obviously people can teach grammar.
blocks.directed: Obviously people can teach grammar.

blocks.text: History.
blocks.directed: History.

blocks.text: Philosophy.
blocks.directed: Philosophy.

blocks.text: Meditation techniques.
blocks.directed: Meditation techniques.

blocks.text: Even if they haven’t attained the supreme condition described here.
blocks.directed: Even if they haven’t attained the supreme condition described here.

blocks.text: The distinction concerns the traditional ideal of the guru as an effective source of liberating recognition.
blocks.directed: The distinction concerns the traditional ideal of the guru as an effective source of liberating recognition.

blocks.text: And here’s where the commentary gets unexpectedly funny.
blocks.directed: And here’s where the commentary gets unexpectedly funny.

blocks.text: Kṣemarāja discusses alternative interpretations of the sūtra that derive elaborate meanings from individual syllables.
blocks.directed: Kṣemarāja discusses alternative interpretations of the sūtra that derive elaborate meanings from individual syllables.

blocks.text: For example, extracting yogīndra from yo, vijñāna from vi, and further meanings from the remaining parts.
blocks.directed: For example, extracting yogīndra from yo, vijñāna from vi, and further meanings from the remaining parts.

blocks.text: The result becomes an intricate symbolic reading.
blocks.directed: The result becomes an intricate symbolic reading.

blocks.text: Very impressive.
blocks.directed: Very impressive.

blocks.text: Lots of Sanskrit.
blocks.directed: Lots of Sanskrit.

blocks.text: Extremely esoteric.
blocks.directed: Extremely esoteric.

blocks.text: Possibly the sort of thing somebody could turn into a three-hour lecture with a beautiful slideshow.
blocks.directed: Possibly the sort of thing somebody could turn into a three-hour lecture with a beautiful slideshow.

blocks.text: But Kṣemarāja doesn’t accept the method in this instance.
blocks.directed: But Kṣemarāja doesn’t accept the method in this instance.

blocks.text: He objects that the proposed interpretation doesn’t fit the intended connection between the words sufficiently well.
blocks.directed: He objects that the proposed interpretation doesn’t fit the intended connection between the words sufficiently well.

blocks.text: And he makes a wonderful methodological point.
blocks.directed: And he makes a wonderful methodological point.

blocks.text: If you’re permitted to extract virtually any meaning from syllabic resemblance, you can generate countless interpretations of every sūtra.
blocks.directed: If you’re permitted to extract virtually any meaning from syllabic resemblance, you can generate countless interpretations of every sūtra.

blocks.text: Which is a rather devastating observation.
blocks.directed: Which is a rather devastating observation.

blocks.text: Because he’s essentially warning against unconstrained Sanskrit mysticism.
blocks.directed: Because he’s essentially warning against unconstrained Sanskrit mysticism.

blocks.text: Not every attractive phonetic coincidence is a valid interpretation.
blocks.directed: Not every attractive phonetic coincidence is a valid interpretation.

blocks.text: Not every elaborate symbolic explanation is faithful to the text.
blocks.directed: Not every elaborate symbolic explanation is faithful to the text.

blocks.text: And the fact that an interpretation sounds extraordinarily profound does not automatically mean it’s philologically justified.
blocks.directed: And the fact that an interpretation sounds extraordinarily profound does not automatically mean it’s philologically justified.

blocks.text: Which is excellent advice for anybody studying Tantra.
blocks.directed: Which is excellent advice for anybody studying Tantra.

blocks.text: You can construct an entire philosophical system out of a word.
blocks.directed: You can construct an entire philosophical system out of a word.

blocks.text: But unless the derivation, context and doctrinal argument support it, you may simply be producing very sophisticated nonsense.
blocks.directed: But unless the derivation, context and doctrinal argument support it, you may simply be producing very sophisticated nonsense.

blocks.text: Kṣemarāja explicitly rejects the alternative syllable-by-syllable interpretation in favour of his explanation through the powers of knowledge and the realised yogi’s sovereignty over them. Sanskrit & Trika Shaivism.
blocks.directed: Kṣemarāja explicitly rejects the alternative syllable-by-syllable interpretation in favour of his explanation through the powers of knowledge and the realised yogi’s sovereignty over them. Sanskrit & Trika Shaivism.

blocks.text: And that makes this sūtra particularly significant.
blocks.directed: And that makes this sūtra particularly significant.

blocks.text: Because it’s not merely describing the ideal spiritual teacher.
blocks.directed: Because it’s not merely describing the ideal spiritual teacher.

blocks.text: It’s also demonstrating something about how the tradition interprets its own scripture.
blocks.directed: It’s also demonstrating something about how the tradition interprets its own scripture.

blocks.text: The words are extraordinarily compressed.
blocks.directed: The words are extraordinarily compressed.

blocks.text: The meanings are often esoteric.
blocks.directed: The meanings are often esoteric.

blocks.text: But interpretation still requires discipline.
blocks.directed: But interpretation still requires discipline.

blocks.text: A profound metaphysical doctrine does not excuse careless reading.
blocks.directed: A profound metaphysical doctrine does not excuse careless reading.

blocks.text: And that brings us to the final sūtra of this instalment.
blocks.directed: And that brings us to the final sūtra of this instalment.

blocks.text: One of the most extraordinary statements in the entire text.
blocks.directed: One of the most extraordinary statements in the entire text.

blocks.text: Because after all the discussion of recognition, liberation, embodiment, mantra, and the teacher’s gift, Vasugupta returns to the fundamental nature of the universe.
blocks.directed: Because after all the discussion of recognition, liberation, embodiment, mantra, and the teacher’s gift, Vasugupta returns to the fundamental nature of the universe.

blocks.text: And announces something absolutely enormous.
blocks.directed: And announces something absolutely enormous.

blocks.text: The entire world is the expansion of the yogi’s own Śakti.
blocks.directed: The entire world is the expansion of the yogi’s own Śakti.

blocks.text: Now that’s a conclusion.
blocks.directed: Now that’s a conclusion.
